changeSet.author: tenagrim
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE "user" ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, date_of_birth DATE NOT NULL, password VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT chk_user_password_length CHECK (char_length(password) >= 8) );

changeSet.author: tenagrim
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE account ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE, balance DECIMAL(19, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, CONSTRAINT fk_account_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT uq_account_user_id UNIQUE (user_id) );

changeSet.author: tenagrim
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE email_data ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL UNIQUE, CONSTRAINT fk_email_data_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );

changeSet.author: tenagrim
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE phone_data ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, phone VARCHAR(13) NOT NULL UNIQUE, CONSTRAINT fk_phone_data_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
